revisionDesc.change: Finalized - Changes requested at voting stage have been implemented, with the exception of the proposed attribution in line 6, because the alt reading added there by Colella was suggested already by Visser in the ed.pr.
Vote - AcceptText - Credit Colella für [σφυρίδ]ι̣α in l. 6?

Vote - AcceptText - Line 24: accept change to circumflex. Alt reading in ln. 6 is fine. Line 7: this should be labeled as reg, not alt reading --> <:ἔχοντα|reg|ἔχουσα:>. Line 11, add space: → BL 7.107. I am reluctant to introduce the proposed regularization in line 8 without seeing an image of the papyrus: [Σαχ]ύ[ψ]εως looks very tenuous. Moreover, Sachypsis is said in the commentary to be an epithet for Isis, but no parallels are adduced. Commentary to line 30, rephrase → It is possible to understand the expression as an error for the nominative οἱ ἡμῶν πάντες ("… Achilleus and all of ours greet you" = "… Achilleus e tutti i nostril ti salutano").
I have corrected αὐτωὶ (l. 24) into αὐτῶι; I have added alternate readings (ll.6, 7 and 30), regularizations (ll. 8 and 27), one BL correction (l. 11) and commentaries (ll. 6-7; 8; 30).
Submit - I have corrected αὐτωὶ (l. 24) into αὐτῶι; I have added alternate readings (ll.6, 7 and 30), regularizations (ll. 8 and 27), one BL correction (l. 11) and commentaries (ll. 6-7; 8; 30).

item.p: The reading ὀ̣λ̣ύ[ρας has been questioned by H. Cadell, Proceed. 12th Congr.Pap., p. 72, n. 26 (cf. BL 6.138).
It is possible to understand the expression as an error for the nominative οἱ ἡμῶν πάντες ("… Achilleus and all of ours greet you" = "… Achilleus e tutti i nostril ti salutano").
